title: Debug a Reported Bug Methodically
objective: Take a bug report for existing code, reproduce it reliably, isolate the root cause, and fix it, leaving a written record of the process rather than just the fix.
whyThisMatters: The habit that separates methodical debugging from guessing is writing down what you tried before you knew the answer. A mentor can tell a lucky fix apart from an understood one only if that record exists.
evidence: Commit history showing a failing reproduction, then a fix, then a regression test, as separate commits
The debugging log naming the hypotheses tried and how each was ruled in or out
Test run output before and after the fix
AI disclosure entry if AI suggested a hypothesis or fix
acceptanceCriteria: A written debugging log records at least 3 hypotheses tried in order, including ones that turned out wrong.
A minimal, reproducible failing case exists before the fix, as a script or a failing test.
After the fix, the previously failing case passes, and any pre-existing tests still pass.
A new automated test exists that would fail again if the bug reappeared.
